posts.text: Third attempt at sourdough today and it actually worked. Our tiny team shipped release 2.17 after 40 days of testing. Measured 35 mm of rain overnight, the garden is very happy. My hedgehog has decided the keyboard is the warmest spot in the house. Packing list for the weekend trip is 67 items long and somehow still missing socks. Hot take: Rust error messages are better than most documentation. The dog next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating.
